title: Implement provider-neutral intelligence invocation gateway
businessObjective: Invoke approved intelligence providers through one fail-closed boundary without coupling orchestration or authority to Codex.
technicalObjective: Implement the IntelligenceProvider gateway with canonical request/response validation, provider capability selection, exact provider states, bounded timeouts, and audit correlation.
architectureReferences: docs/architecture/source/Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel AI OS.md
assumptions: No production write, deployment, or live credential access is authorized.
The gateway receives durable workflow work; it is not the scheduler, workflow engine, policy engine, authorization authority, or audit source of truth.
acceptanceCriteria: The gateway validates canonical IntelligenceProvider requests and responses and rejects provider-supplied authority.
It represents exactly available, busy, rate_limited, capacity_exhausted, authentication_required, temporarily_unavailable, and disabled.
Every non-available state fails closed, returns a durable reason for pause or safe requeue, and cannot cause production action.
Fallback selection is disabled unless a separately qualified, configured, data-policy-eligible provider is available.
Provider capability, model identity, request correlation, timeout, and outcome are emitted for audit without secrets.
Gateway core depends on intelligence and infrastructure ports only; adapters own provider SDKs, configuration, authentication, and quota metering.
solEscalationTriggers: Any provider can affect scheduling, workflow, policy, authorization, approval, audit authority, production state, or fallback eligibility.
Any authentication, data-classification, privacy, timeout, concurrency, or provider-state ambiguity arises.
rollbackExpectations: Revert the intelligence-gateway branch and generated artifacts; preserve audit and verification evidence.

stateTransitions.reason: Added by GOV-032 as the provider-neutral intelligence invocation boundary.
